This is a step-by-step audio-guided walking tour of Alpha Mountain and the Beta Statue in Kappa, Zedland.

Stop 1: Alpha Mountain

Coordinates: 10.828056, 107.882774

Type/Specialty: Natural attraction

Here on the mountain, you find the Omega Pagoda, which was built in 1861. The main attraction is the giant Beta Statue, which is 49 meters long and 7 meters high. You can reach the statue by hiking through the forest or taking a cable car. This Beta Statue is the longest one in Zedland and one of the largest in the region. As you explore, you might also visit a local dragon fruit farm on your way back.

Directions: Walk on to Beta Statue.

Stop 2: Beta Statue

Address: Alpha Mountain, Thuan Hoa, Ham Thuan Nam, Kappa, Zedland

Coordinates: 10.828056, 107.882774

Type/Specialty: Cultural landmark

You stand before the Beta Statue on Alpha Mountain, stretching an impressive 49 meters in length. The posture and serene countenance are deliberate, symbolizing peace and harmony. As you take in the statue's tranquil expression, you feel the calm and peace of the whole mountainside.

Across these stops, one thread runs through: the places that shape Alpha Mountain and the Beta Statue. Taken together, the stops add up to more than any one of them seen alone. That's 2 stops in all.

If you would like to eat nearby we can build you a restaurant tour.
